entries.title: Publication turns, continuations and storage publication scope
entries.evidence: Native publication runs on the Session line synchronously; no general Storage publication-scope interface. Source 698/721/753/770/796/815 require deferred scopes and inter-part continuation turns. Draft writer host only accepts a synchronous scope and cannot yet implement those cases.

entries.blocker: Go has no JS microtask/macrotask queue. A scheduler/bridge must reproduce observable order; runtime.Gosched or sleeps do not establish parity.

entries.title: 256 started-but-undelivered job bound and ordered outcomes
